brandbook.positioning: Prototipo ficticio de una taquería cuyo menú se conecta directamente con una comanda editable. Productos y precios de demostración, sin cobros, preparación real ni afirmaciones sobre un negocio existente.
brandbook.voice: Español directo, cálido y preciso. Acciones completas como Añadir, Revisar pedido y Conservar pedido. Distinguir pendiente, guardado y resultado incierto sin tecnicismos innecesarios ni promesas operativas.
brandbook.motif: La tortilla plegada inspira el pequeño pliegue de identificación de la comanda. Un borde continuo enlaza referencias seleccionadas, especificación y acción; no introducir celdas vacías obligatorias, texturas fotográficas ni adornos que tapen contenido.

pages.title: Brand guidelines
pages.summary: Prototipo ficticio de una taquería cuyo menú se conecta directamente con una comanda editable. Productos y precios de demostración, sin cobros, preparación real ni afirmaciones sobre un negocio existente.

examples.text: Menú y comanda, en una misma superficie.

examples.title: Cover composition
examples.text: Use a 32 px outer margin, a 40 px title and a compact cream support behind the complete symbol.

pages.title: The Brand
pages.summary: Use Roast Red #A83224 for this divider, with cream typography and generous empty space. Introduce the connected menu and comanda rather than a promotional restaurant story.

examples.title: Una selección clara
examples.text: Elige productos, ajusta cantidades y revisa tu pedido de demostración.

examples.title: Divider rhythm
examples.text: Place the tortilla symbol above the heading. Keep the introductory line within a short, left-aligned column.

pages.title: Welcome
pages.summary: Public research could not be completed. This guide presents a proposed identity based on the supplied brief.

examples.title: Bienvenido a Taquería Monterey
examples.text: Explora el menú y prepara una selección de demostración.

examples.title: One notice per view
examples.text: Prototipo ficticio · Productos y precios de demostración · Sin cobros ni preparación real.

pages.title: Index
pages.summary: Organize the manual into identity, visual system and applications. Use bold section names, regular page ranges and consistent left alignment; do not turn the index into a dense grid.

examples.title: Identity · 5–15
examples.text: Definition, editorial principles and the folded-tortilla logo.

examples.title: Visual system · 16–29
examples.text: Typography, layout, color, local illustrations and visual references.

examples.title: Applications · 30–49
examples.text: Design studies for the three-view prototype and selected identity surfaces.

pages.title: Defining
pages.summary: Define Taquería Monterey through its connected comanda: selection, quantities and review share one continuous surface. Avoid a separate promotional hero or a receipt detached from the menu.

examples.title: Menú
examples.text: Elige tus productos y revisa tu selección en la comanda.

examples.title: Tu comanda
examples.text: Aquí aparecen solo los productos que añades.

pages.title: Vision & Mission
pages.summary: Treat these as project intent, not a real company's declarations. Express the aim through clear selection and honest saved-state feedback; avoid claims about food quality or service.

examples.title: Project direction
examples.text: Keep choosing, editing and reviewing connected without losing the selected products.

examples.title: Editorial expression
examples.text: Revisa tu selección antes de guardar el pedido de demostración.

pages.title: Brand Values
pages.summary: Use clarity, continuity and honesty as proposed design principles, not corporate facts. Each principle must affect visible hierarchy, retained context or precise status language.

examples.title: Clarity
examples.text: Show “Taco de pastor · $22.00 MXN” beside its quantity control, not inside the illustration.

examples.title: Continuity
examples.text: Keep the selected taco and its quantity visible during review and confirmation.

examples.title: Honesty
examples.text: Use “No pudimos confirmar si se guardó” when the result remains uncertain.

pages.title: Tone of Voice
pages.summary: Write interface copy in direct, warm Spanish. Name the action and its outcome without jokes, technical jargon or operational promises. Distinguish saving from preparation and uncertainty from failure.

examples.title: Action
examples.text: Revisar pedido

examples.title: Validation
examples.text: Escribe un nombre de entre 2 y 80 caracteres.

examples.title: Uncertain outcome
examples.text: Aún no sabemos si el pedido se guardó. Usa Recuperar pedido para consultar el resultado.

pages.title: Logo
pages.summary: Open the logo chapter on Golden Maize #F0C463. Present the complete symbol on its cream support and the name in Cocoa Ink; keep explanatory copy below, never inside the mark.

examples.title: Taquería Monterey
examples.text: Una tortilla plegada identifica el menú y su comanda.

examples.title: Chapter composition
examples.text: Use one large lockup, one short caption and clear space on all sides.

pages.title: Logo overview
pages.summary: The identity combines an original folded-tortilla symbol with a separately typeset name. Preserve the maize shell, ink contour, red fold and cream circular support as one fixed symbol.

examples.title: Full signature
examples.text: Use the symbol beside “Taquería Monterey” in the shared application header.

examples.title: Compact signature
examples.text: Use the symbol alone only where the full name is already visible, such as a nearby browser title.

pages.title: Primary logo
pages.summary: Typeset both words in Atkinson Hyperlegible 700. Stack Taquería above Monterey, with Monterey approximately twice its size. Align the symbol to the combined name block.

examples.title: Header lockup
examples.text: Taquería at 16 px and Monterey at 32 px; use a 64 px symbol with a 12 px gap.

examples.title: Narrow header
examples.text: Reduce the lockup proportionally or move navigation below it. Never shorten the name to fit.

pages.title: Logo Safezone
pages.summary: Let x equal one quarter of the symbol width. Reserve at least x around the complete lockup, measured from its outermost edges. Keep navigation, borders and illustrations outside this area.

examples.title: 64 px symbol
examples.text: Leave at least 16 px around the Taquería Monterey lockup.

examples.title: Standalone application
examples.text: A 32 mm symbol requires 8 mm of clear space beyond its cream support.

pages.title: Color combinations
pages.summary: Keep symbol colors unchanged on every background. On cream or maize, use an ink name; on ink or red, use a cream name. The symbol's cream support must remain fully visible.

examples.title: Cream header
examples.text: Warm Cream background, Cocoa Ink name and the full-color tortilla symbol.

examples.title: Red divider
examples.text: Roast Red background, cream name and the same supported symbol without recoloring.

pages.title: Brandmark
pages.summary: Use the folded tortilla as the only identity symbol. Its red corner suggests the comanda fold; do not replace it with initials, a pepper, a sombrero or a generic taco emoji.

examples.title: Comanda detail
examples.text: Echo the red fold once at the comanda heading, leaving product names and controls unobstructed.

examples.title: Small symbol
examples.text: Use the complete 160 × 160 geometry. Remove surrounding decoration rather than simplifying individual paths.

pages.title: Logo misuse
pages.summary: Do not stretch, rotate, crop, recolor or add effects to the symbol. Keep the business name in real typography and preserve its accent. Never place text across the tortilla.

examples.title: Incorrect
examples.text: “Taqueria Monterrey” changes both the accent and the supplied business name.

examples.title: Correct
examples.text: Taquería Monterey

examples.title: Background correction
examples.text: On a maize panel, retain the cream support instead of drawing a white outline around the symbol.

pages.title: Typography
pages.summary: Introduce typography with a large Spanish headline and a short supporting line. Use only Atkinson Hyperlegible, in 400 and 700; let weight and spacing create contrast rather than decorative styles.

examples.title: Elige con claridad
examples.text: Consulta el menú, ajusta cantidades y revisa tu selección.

examples.title: Divider treatment
examples.text: Set the headline at 40 px/700 and the supporting line at 16 px/400, separated by 16 px.

pages.title: Typography overview
pages.summary: Use one family across the name, menu, fields and statuses. Keep sentence case and Spanish accents. Align descriptions and prices consistently so product choice remains the main reading task.

examples.title: Taco de champiñones
examples.text: Tacos · $24.00 MXN

examples.title: Character coverage
examples.text: Preserve ñ, í and ó in “champiñones”, “Taquería” and “demostración”; never remove accents for visual convenience.

pages.title: Primary typeface
pages.summary: Atkinson Hyperlegible is the supplied project typeface. Regular 400 and Bold 700 files are available for local use; keep both headings and body copy in this family.

examples.title: Revisa tu pedido
examples.text: Comprueba productos, cantidades y datos de recogida antes de confirmar.

examples.title: Readable setting
examples.text: Use 16 px body text with approximately 24 px line height; avoid tightly packed instructions beneath fields.

pages.title: Typography
pages.summary: Use weight 700 for the name, headings, totals and primary labels; use 400 for descriptions and supporting copy. Avoid italics, ornamental capitals, synthetic weights and compressed lettering.

examples.title: Total de demostración
examples.text: 2 × Taco de pastor · $44.00 MXN

examples.title: Weight contrast
examples.text: Set “Total de demostración” and its amount in 700. Keep quantity details and explanatory text in 400.

pages.title: Supporting type
pages.summary: Use Atkinson Hyperlegible 400 for secondary information, not a second display family. Secondary text may be 12–14 px; navigation and buttons stay at least 14 px, fields at 16 px.

examples.title: Notas opcionales
examples.text: Puedes escribir hasta 500 caracteres.

examples.title: Secondary information
examples.text: Use 14 px ink text for helper copy on cream. Reserve Toasted Edge primarily for borders, not small essential text.

pages.title: Hierarchy
pages.summary: Set page titles at 28–40 px, section headings at 20–24 px and body text at 16 px. Give the current action strong weight without letting it compete with the page title.

examples.title: Tu demostración
examples.text: Administra los productos y pedidos de esta sesión.

examples.title: Applied scale
examples.text: Tu demostración: 32 px/700. Productos: 24 px/700. Product names: 18 px/700. Descriptions: 16 px/400.

pages.title: Layouts
pages.summary: Use a 4/8/12/16/24/32 px spacing scale and 8 px corners. Desktop places catalog left and comanda right; at 768 px use two catalog columns with checkout at available width, then stack on narrow screens.

examples.title: 390 px composition
examples.text: Identity and navigation lead into notice, search, filters, first product and access to the comanda. Let text determine height.

examples.title: Continuous comanda
examples.text: Selected references lead directly into lines, total and action. Keep all eight selected lines in normal flow when needed.

pages.title: Colors
pages.summary: Introduce the palette with cream as the dominant field, ink for reading and red for action. Maize brings warmth to selected surfaces; toasted borders organize content without heavy boxes.

examples.title: Warm, clear, grounded
examples.text: Cream catalog · ink labels · red Añadir button · maize comanda heading.

examples.title: Divider treatment
examples.text: Use one Roast Red panel with cream text rather than five equally weighted color blocks.

pages.title: Colors overview
pages.summary: Preserve all five palette hex values. Add #286344 only as Confirmed Green for confirmed results; it is not an alternate accent, category color or pending-state indicator.

examples.title: Core roles
examples.text: Background: Warm Cream #FFF5E5. Surface: Golden Maize #F0C463. Accent: Roast Red #A83224.

examples.title: Reading and structure
examples.text: Text: Cocoa Ink #302019. Muted/border: Toasted Edge #897465. Prefer ink for essential copy.

examples.title: Confirmed result
examples.text: “Pedido de demostración guardado” may use #286344. Keep the separate “Pendiente” status neutral.

pages.title: Using Tints
pages.summary: Prefer the supplied solid colors over new tints. Keep cream behind long text and maize on compact headers. Do not lower text or control opacity to communicate disabled, pending or error states.

examples.title: Quiet surface
examples.text: Use a cream product card with a Toasted Edge border; avoid translucent red behind product descriptions.

examples.title: Pending status
examples.text: Show “Pendiente” in ink on cream with a border, not pale green or an unlabeled colored dot.

pages.title: Graphic Elements
pages.summary: Use the fold and continuous comanda border as the signature graphic language. Reserve space for real selections; never create eight empty slots, decorative receipt tears or food textures.

examples.title: Single selection
examples.text: One Taco de pastor reference sits in a compact frame directly above its editable line.

examples.title: Several selections
examples.text: Taco de asada and Agua de jamaica form a continuous list, with one shared total and action edge.

pages.title: Icons
pages.summary: Use simple local line icons with ink strokes and consistent geometry. Icons support visible labels; quantity controls need product-specific accessible names and touch targets of at least 44 px.

examples.title: Quantity controls
examples.text: Accessible names: “Aumentar cantidad de Taco de pastor” and “Reducir cantidad de Taco de pastor”.

examples.title: Explicit removal
examples.text: Use “Quitar” beside its icon. At quantity one, minus must not silently remove the product.

examples.title: Navigation
examples.text: Keep Menú, Mis pedidos and Administrar as text labels even when accompanied by icons.

pages.title: Illustration, not photography
pages.summary: Replace photography with eight local conceptual SVG illustrations. Use complete contours and consistent geometry; distinguish ingredients without suggesting portion sizes or borrowing another product's image.

examples.title: Six tacos
examples.text: Pastor, asada, pollo, champiñones, papa and frijoles each receive a distinct conceptual filling within the same visual frame.

examples.title: Two beverages
examples.text: Agua de jamaica and Agua de horchata use distinct local cup illustrations without volume claims.

examples.title: Missing reference
examples.text: Keep the original product name and illustration frame visible; offer recovery instead of substituting another taco.

pages.title: Moodboard
pages.summary: Build the reference board from the supplied palette, tortilla geometry, legible type and connected comanda. Exclude stock food photos, rustic textures and generic restaurant dashboards.

examples.title: Chosen direction
examples.text: Comanda conectada: a maize heading, ink border and selected product references continuing into editable lines.

examples.title: Supporting references
examples.text: Cream space, red action labels, rounded 8 px corners and a clear Atkinson Hyperlegible price specimen.

pages.title: Applications
pages.summary: All applications in this section are design studies. Carry the same name, supported symbol, palette and connected-comanda hierarchy across screens and illustrative physical surfaces.

examples.title: Del menú a tu comanda
examples.text: Elige, ajusta y revisa una selección de demostración.

examples.title: Study boundaries
examples.text: Physical and social studies add no business address, account, payment service or extra application route.

pages.title: Social media icons
pages.summary: Design study: center the supported tortilla symbol within a square avatar. Leave crop tolerance around the cream circle; do not add a platform badge, initials or a fictional account handle.

examples.title: Taquería Monterey
examples.text: Identidad de un prototipo ficticio.

examples.title: Avatar crop
examples.text: Use a cream square with the full symbol at 80% width. Keep the entire tortilla visible in circular crops.

pages.title: Social media profiles
pages.summary: Design study: use the exact name as the profile heading and a plain explanatory bio. Pair an uncluttered cream banner with the avatar; omit contact links, location and invented social accounts.

examples.title: Taquería Monterey
examples.text: Menú y pedidos de demostración. Sin cobros ni preparación real.

examples.title: Profile hierarchy
examples.text: Keep the name above the bio. Use the comanda border as a banner detail, not a simulated platform control.

pages.title: Instagram posts
pages.summary: Design study: feature one local illustration, one product name and one supplied demonstration price. Use cream backgrounds and ink headings; do not add discounts or delivery claims.

examples.title: Taco de pastor
examples.text: $22.00 MXN · Producto y precio de demostración.

examples.title: Agua de jamaica
examples.text: $25.00 MXN · Explora la categoría Bebidas.

examples.title: Post composition
examples.text: Place the illustration above the name and price, with a small complete lockup below. Avoid text over the food silhouette.

pages.title: Posters
pages.summary: Design study: use a typographic menu poster, not an event or opening announcement. Group only the supplied products into Tacos and Bebidas, with a clear demonstration caption.

examples.title: Un menú para explorar
examples.text: Tacos y bebidas de demostración. Sin cobros ni preparación real.

examples.title: Tacos
examples.text: Pastor $22.00 · Asada $28.00 · Pollo $24.00 · Champiñones $24.00 · Papa $20.00 · Frijoles $20.00. Precios en MXN.

examples.title: Bebidas
examples.text: Agua de jamaica $25.00 MXN · Agua de horchata $25.00 MXN.

pages.title: T shirts and totes
pages.summary: Design study: use the full-color supported symbol on cream fabric, with the name separately typeset below. Keep decoration away from seams; do not imply merchandise is available to buy.

examples.title: Taquería Monterey
examples.text: Menú y comanda.

examples.title: Tote layout
examples.text: Center one symbol and one name block. Leave at least one quarter-symbol width of clear space around the lockup.

pages.title: Takeaway packaging
pages.summary: Design study: apply the identity to a cream sleeve with a small maize panel. Keep the symbol intact and avoid claims about materials, portion sizes, freshness or an actual packaging service.

examples.title: Tu selección, a la vista
examples.text: Taquería Monterey · Estudio de empaque.

examples.title: Sleeve composition
examples.text: Place the full lockup on the broad face. Keep the red fold away from the sleeve seam and leave the reverse uncluttered.

pages.title: Pickup request panel
pages.summary: Design study: represent pickup as fields inside the expanded comanda on /. Show no map, address or business hours. Label the requested time without implying availability or a real collection point.

examples.title: Datos de recogida
examples.text: Indica tu nombre y un horario solicitado. Las notas son opcionales.

examples.title: Horario solicitado
examples.text: Usa el formato HH:mm. Este dato no confirma disponibilidad ni preparación real.

examples.title: Field placement
examples.text: Place persistent labels above full-width fields. Keep selected references and the total in the same flowing comanda.

pages.title: Ordering controls
pages.summary: Design study: use red for the current primary action and ink text for secondary actions. Keep 44 px targets, visible focus and labels. Animate an added line for 160 ms; remove motion when requested.

examples.title: Añadir
examples.text: Taco de pastor · Cantidad: 2 · $44.00 MXN

examples.title: Action sequence
examples.text: Añadir → Continuar con mi pedido → Revisar pedido → Confirmar pedido. Keep every step within Menú.

examples.title: Accessible feedback
examples.text: “Taco de pastor añadido. Cantidad en la comanda: 2.” Announce without moving focus or relying on animation.

pages.title: Order receipt
pages.summary: Design study: make the confirmed result the continuation of the comanda, not a payment receipt. Show a folio only after confirmed saving; retain selected references, historical lines and pickup details.

examples.title: Pedido de demostración guardado
examples.text: Estado: Pendiente · Sin cobros ni preparación real.

examples.title: Saved selection specimen
examples.text: 2 × Taco de pastor: $44.00 MXN. 1 × Agua de jamaica: $25.00 MXN. Total: $69.00 MXN.

examples.title: Result composition
examples.text: Place the server-returned folio beneath the result heading, followed by Ver mis pedidos and Volver al menú.

pages.title: Demo reference card
pages.summary: Design study replacing a rewards card: explain the prototype's three views on a simple cream card. Do not introduce loyalty points, stamps, memberships or rewards.

examples.title: Explora tu demostración
examples.text: Menú para elegir · Mis pedidos para consultar · Administrar para editar.

examples.title: Card hierarchy
examples.text: Use the full name on the front and three short view descriptions on the reverse. Avoid serial numbers or membership language.

pages.title: Demo title sign
pages.summary: Design study: treat signage as an exhibition title panel, not evidence of a restaurant location. Use an ink field, cream name and unchanged supported symbol; omit opening hours and directional arrows.

examples.title: Taquería Monterey
examples.text: Prototipo ficticio de menú y pedidos.

examples.title: Distance hierarchy
examples.text: Make Monterey dominant, keep Taquería legible above it and place the explanatory line beneath the full lockup.

pages.title: Ordering website
pages.summary: Design study: keep exactly three views with visible navigation: /, /pedidos and /administrar. Checkout stays within Menú. Present session-scoped Turso saving honestly; never simulate success when saving is blocked.

examples.title: Menú
examples.text: Buscar productos · Todo · Tacos · Bebidas

examples.title: Mis pedidos
examples.text: Aún no tienes pedidos guardados. Volver al menú.

examples.title: No pudimos iniciar tu sesión
examples.text: Necesitamos la cookie de sesión para guardar tu demostración. Reintentar.

pages.title: Favicon
pages.summary: Design study: derive the favicon and touch icon from the exact tortilla symbol, including its cream support. Use no initials or template icon; keep the tab title in Spanish.

examples.title: Menú · Taquería Monterey
examples.text: Explora productos y prepara tu pedido de demostración.

examples.title: Small-format treatment
examples.text: Center the complete geometry on a cream canvas. Do not crop the red fold or redraw the outline for a smaller size.

pages.title: Stationery
pages.summary: Design study: use stationery for project notes, not commercial invoices. Keep the full lockup at the top, ink body text on cream and one toasted divider; omit invented contact details.

examples.title: Notas de la demostración
examples.text: Taquería Monterey · Menú, comanda y estados del pedido.

examples.title: Page structure
examples.text: Use a 32 px inset, a compact header and generous writing space. Keep the red fold as a single corner detail.

pages.title: Project cards
pages.summary: Design study adapting business cards: introduce the fictional project without a named employee, address, phone or account. Use a clear front-and-back hierarchy instead of a simulated contact card.

examples.title: Taquería Monterey
examples.text: Un prototipo para elegir, revisar y guardar pedidos de demostración.

examples.title: Reverse side
examples.text: Menú · Mis pedidos · Administrar. No login, payment or contact fields belong on this study.

pages.title: Demo invitation card
pages.summary: Design study replacing a gift card: invite exploration without stored value, redemption codes or discounts. Use a maize face, ink headline and the supported tortilla symbol.

examples.title: Prueba una selección
examples.text: Explora seis tacos y dos bebidas de demostración.

examples.title: Scope caption
examples.text: Tarjeta conceptual · Sin valor monetario.

pages.title: Packaging seal
pages.summary: Design study: center the unchanged tortilla symbol on a cream circular seal. If the name is included, place it below the symbol in straight lines, not curved or squeezed around the edge.

examples.title: Taquería Monterey
examples.text: Estudio de identidad.

examples.title: Seal restraint
examples.text: Use the mark without freshness, safety or tamper-proof claims. Preserve its cream support and clear space.

pages.title: In-app assistance
pages.summary: Design study adapting customer support: put help beside the relevant action, with no invented contact channel. Distinguish empty, invalid, blocked and uncertain states; preserve entered values during recovery.

examples.title: Recuperar pedido
examples.text: No pudimos confirmar el resultado. Consulta el mismo intento antes de iniciar otro pedido.

examples.title: ¿Cancelar este pedido?
examples.text: Conservar pedido · Confirmar cancelación. La cancelación solo está disponible mientras el pedido siga pendiente.

examples.title: El producto cambió
examples.text: Compara tu selección con los datos actuales y decide cómo continuar antes de revisar de nuevo.

pages.title: Thank you
pages.summary: Public research could not be completed. This guide presents a proposed identity based on the supplied brief.

examples.title: Gracias por explorar Taquería Monterey
examples.text: Una demostración para elegir con claridad y mantener tu selección a la vista.

examples.title: Colophon
examples.text: Original folded-tortilla mark created for this fictional project. Supplied product names and MXN prices are demonstration data, not real business claims.
